notes: Summary: Enterprise consortium of regional hospitals + research labs evaluating Redwood Private (on-prem air-gapped variant) to power clinician-facing summarization and PII extraction pipelines.
Priority: High - regulatory drivers (HIPAA + state-level residency), must be fully air-gapped for one major hospital network.
Decision makers: CTO (R. Alvarez), Head of InfoSec (N. Patel), Director of Clinical AI (L. Morgan). AE/Champion: Jordan Park.
POC ask: 4-week air-gapped pilot in customer data center (VM/GPU nodes provided by customer), installer delivered as tarball + signed checksums, offline license activation.
Security wishlist: HSM-backed KMS integration (YubiHSM + AWS CloudHSM acceptable), audit log export to on-prem Splunk, configurable retention up to 7 years, SSO via SAML with SCIM user sync.
Data residency: All inference and KV/prefix cache must remain in customer VPC / on-prem; no outbound telemetry without explicit allow-list (customer to approve list).

Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open models or customer-supplied fine-tuned checkpoints (Llama2-70B, Mistral large variants). Want ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant during capacity events.
Latency/Throughput targets: p95 latency < 300ms for clinician UI (short prompts), baseline 20 concurrent interactive sessions, batch jobs for de-id at 50 reqs/min.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — more sensitive to predictability than lowest unit cost; reserved commit for baseline throughput likely.
